acceptance_reasons: Built an offline, network-free PIT SEC filer-status proxy surface from local dei:EntityPublicFloat threshold crossings for all 297 canonical-window 10-K/10-Q events (46/48 CIKs have public-float data).
Census resolves the exp-010..015 blocker: the filer-status-upgrade signal is structurally untradeable in the curated warehouse, so no further cover-page-text network materialization is warranted.

census.in_window_detail: All 4 are UP-crossings to large_accelerated in non-warehouse float-explosion names: CIFR 2025-02-25, CORZ 2025-02-27, WULF 2025-03-03, APLD 2025-07-30.

result.summary: SEC filer category is defined by public-float thresholds and dei:EntityPublicFloat is already in the local companyfacts cache, so the DEI filer-status surface that exp-010..015 chased via failing network cover-page fetches is materializable OFFLINE as a PIT float-threshold proxy. The census then shows the line is structurally untradeable: 0 of the 4 in-window filer-status transitions touch any of the 38 tradeable warehouse names (all permanently large-accelerated); the only transitions are float-explosion small/mid names (CIFR, WULF, APLD, CORZ) outside the warehouse, where broad-universe expansion was already rejected and the signal is momentum-confounded and stale-dated.

production_impact.parity_note: Read-only offline materialization audit. Consumes the existing local companyfacts cache, SEC event log, and warehouse snapshots; writes only an experiment-owned artifact. No shared helper, daily adapter, order, rank, size, exit, watchlist, or LLM behavior changed.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: SEC filer category (large-accelerated/accelerated/non-accelerated) is a deterministic function of public float, and dei:EntityPublicFloat is a numeric DEI fact already cached per-filing, so the surface the cover-page-text line kept failing to fetch is derivable offline. But in the curated ~50-name megacap warehouse public float is permanently >> $700M, so filer status never transitions; the only in-window transitions are crypto/AI-datacenter float explosions (CIFR/CORZ/WULF/APLD) outside the tradeable universe. Signal and tradeable universe are disjoint.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not continue materializing 10-K/10-Q cover-page TEXT for filer-status alpha (exp-010..015 line), and do not sweep float thresholds, status categories, hold, cooldown, or notional. Even perfect cover-page data yields 0 tradeable in-window transitions. Do not re-open via broad-universe expansion to reach the float-explosion names (already rejected) without solving the momentum-confound and stale-dating first.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A tradeable filer-status edge would need (a) a universe that already passed expansion review AND contains pre-graduation float-explosion names, plus (b) a PIT field that isolates the eligibility transition from the coincident price run-up (e.g. forward replacement-value rows on freshly-graduated names tagged at entry by float-crossing recency). Absent that, treat filer status as descriptive registrant context, not entry alpha.
